raw_text: Post-Prigozhin Wagner reorganization in Libya is significant for African energy security. Satellite imagery confirms new camps near Es Sider oil terminal. Russia consolidating PMC ops under Africa Corps / GRU banner. This positions Moscow to leverage Libyan oil exports as geopolitical tool. India should monitor — Libya is a key crude supplier to Indian refineries.
